STEP 1 - Scene: A plated lunch or dinner: grilled/roasted fish or chicken fillets with a crust of seeds, Brussels sprouts, a leafy salad with creamy dressing, and cucumber slices. Photographed from above at a slight angle on a glass table.

STEP 2 - Ruler: A square white plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 530 cm² (treating it as a 26 cm disc-equivalent).

STEP 3 - Items:
- Grilled fish fillet (two pieces, one on the lower edge, one upper-right)
- Brussels sprouts (about 5 small halves/whole)
- Salad leaves with creamy dressing (mixed greens, pale lettuce, a little dressing)
- Cucumber slices (3)
- A small piece of meat or fried item near the salad

STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate, food covers ~55%):
- Grilled fish fillets: 22% (≈117 cm²)
- Brussels sprouts: 8% (≈42 cm²)
- Salad with dressing: 14% (≈74 cm²)
- Meat/chicken piece: 6% (≈32 cm²)
- Cucumber slices: 5% (≈27 cm²)

STEP 5 - Volume (height estimates):
- Fish: 117 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 140 ml
- Brussels sprouts: 42 × 2 ≈ 84 ml
- Salad with dressing: 74 × 2.5 ≈ 185 ml
- Meat piece: 32 × 1.2 ≈ 38 ml
- Cucumber: 27 × 0.8 ≈ 22 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk density):
- Fish: 140 × 0.95 ≈ 133 g
- Brussels sprouts: 84 × 0.6 ≈ 50 g
- Salad with dressing: 185 × 0.15 ≈ 28 g
- Meat piece: 38 × 0.95 ≈ 36 g
- Cucumber: 22 × 0.6 ≈ 13 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Fish (cooked, mixed fillet): 133 g × 180 kcal/100 g ≈ 240 kcal
- Brussels sprouts: 50 g × 43 kcal/100 g ≈ 22 kcal
- Salad with creamy dressing: 28 g × 80 kcal/100 g ≈ 22 kcal
- Meat piece: 36 g × 200 kcal/100 g ≈ 72 kcal
- Cucumber: 13 g × 15 kcal/100 g ≈ 2 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 285 g and ≈ 358 kcal. This is plausible for a partly covered dinner plate with a modest protein portion and vegetables.
